findings.evidence: The file is under `Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/MatrixCoefficient`, imports `Comodule.MatrixCoefficient.Matrix`, and lines 38–152 require no general-linear definitions; the neighboring coefficient-matrix API is declared in `namespace TauCeti.Comodule` in `Matrix.lean:52`.
findings.fix: Move these declarations to `TauCeti.Comodule` and update the general-linear and upper-unitriangular consumers to use that canonical namespace.
findings.issue: `matrixCoact`, `map_comul_iff`, `map_counit_iff`, `matrixComodule`, and their characteristic lemmas are placed in `TauCeti.GeneralLinear`, although their statements use only matrices, bialgebras, and comodules; this gives reusable comodule infrastructure a misleading algebraic-group API.

summary: The generic comodule-from-matrix API is exposed under the general-linear namespace despite being coalgebra/comodule infrastructure independent of general linear groups.
